dedupe_keys.name: senegal geolocated health facility full list

description: The Senegal consolidated-facility-list team publishes a full list of health facility observations as a public Figshare CSV under CC0. The describing article reports 12,965 observations assembled from 16 source lists before matching duplicate facilities. The full list preserves more granular attributes than the companion consolidated file and links to it through a match identifier. A health-service modeller can use these observations to inspect facility coverage, potential service demand or emergency access, subject to checking coordinate quality. A caveat is that multiple rows can refer to one physical facility, and some source lists differ in ownership, naming and geolocation. Treating every row as a separate operating asset would overstate capacity. The consolidated 4,685-facility list has its own Figshare DOI. I read the own file metadata and article Data Records without downloading the CSV, checking individual facilities or estimating service capacity. No directly related catalogue record was identified. Emergency-response and facility-capacity simulation are potential uses.
